articles.title: Microsoft just shared Azure’s actual revenue in dollars: $33.2 billion
articles.description: Microsoft has never disclosed Azure's quarterly revenue in dollars. But for the first time, we can see just how close it is getting to besting the biggest competitor in the market, AWS.

articles.title: Google expands AI Search ads globally as core ad growth slows
articles.description: The announcement came alongside parent company Alphabet's third-quarter earnings report, which saw revenue grow 25% year over year to $127.6 billion.

articles.title: Canadian ‘crypto king’ case to go to jury as criminal trial winds down
articles.description: Aiden Pleterski, facing fraud charges in Canada over his alleged role in a digital asset Ponzi scheme, said that he was innocent at closing.

articles.title: Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI
articles.description: Microsoft said it made $10 billion in revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI, including revenue-sharing payments, in the quarter ending September 30. It underscores the still-enormous financial dependency of the partnership.

articles.title: Microsoft hits 10 quarters of record-breaking revenue in a row
articles.description: Whatever the future of AI might be, the current situation is still very good for Microsoft. The tech giant reported yet another record for quarterly revenue on Wednesday: $92.3 billion, a 19% increase over the year-ago quarter.

articles.title: Bitcoin-backed mortgages are coming to Canada, but borrowers are still unaware of the cost
articles.description: Prospective borrowers face collateral liquidation risks if bitcoin prices drop, though APX said property and crypto collateral will be handled distinctly.

articles.title: Hacker stole personnel data about thousands of Homeland Security employees, including CBP and ICE agents
articles.description: A hacker obtained personally identifiable information about more than 40,000 Homeland Security staffers, which has since been published online.

articles.title: Anthropic just launched tools to show companies what their AI spending is buying

articles.title: Sam Bankman-Fried wrote to actor portraying him in Netflix series
articles.description: The former FTX CEO remains incarcerated as Irish actor Anthony Boyle portrays him in a series about the downfall of the crypto exchange and his relationship with Caroline Ellison.

articles.title: CFTC chief poses questions about policing AI but calls it a road to 'autonomous trading'
articles.description: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission held a forum in which the chairman, Mike Selig, suggested AI agents may usher in a financial revolution.

articles.title: Crypto isn’t a partisan fight, proven by data
articles.description: Treating crypto as a political battleground only makes it harder to build the secure, transparent, American-made financial system that most Americans say they want, argues DeFi Education Fund’s Jennifer Rosenthal.

articles.title: Strategy shareholders approve daily dividends for four preferred stocks
articles.description: The largest Bitcoin treasury company will begin daily dividend payments on STRC in November, with three other preferred securities following in January 2027.

articles.title: Fed leaves interest rates unchanged, as expected
articles.description: A rate hike in December remains likely as the U.S. central bank continues to focus on inflation, which remains well above its 2% target.

articles.title: As AI agents reshape the web, Google opens Gemini and Search to more apps
